title: 2026 Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation carbon and sustainability assurance QA controls

sources.title: RTFO and SAF Mandate third party assurance

facts.source_fact: The RTFO is designed to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions from surface transport by encouraging low-carbon fuels.
facts.expected_handling: Treat RTFO as a transport-fuel scheme rather than a parcel emissions source.

facts.source_fact: The RTFO requires relevant UK transport-fuel suppliers to meet an annual obligation for sustainable low-carbon fuel supply.
facts.expected_handling: Attach obligation year and supplier boundary to compliance records.

facts.source_fact: The RTFO operates as a certificate-trading mechanism.
facts.expected_handling: Keep certificate status separate from physical fuel quantities and GHG values.

facts.source_fact: Certificates are issued for eligible low-carbon fuel supplied under the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Apply eligibility before assigning certificate value.

facts.source_fact: RTFO guidance supports fuel suppliers, independent verifiers and other scheme participants.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve participant-role metadata.

facts.source_fact: Carbon and sustainability data must be independently verified before renewable transport fuel certificates are awarded.
facts.expected_handling: Reject certificate-ready status when assurance evidence is absent.

facts.source_fact: Low-carbon fuel suppliers applying for certificates must appoint a recognised independent verifier.
facts.expected_handling: Require recognised-verifier provenance with assured data.

facts.source_fact: Recognised verifiers provide limited assurance that carbon and sustainability information meets the applicable criteria for RTFO certificates.
facts.expected_handling: Label assurance level explicitly.

facts.source_fact: Recognised RTFO verifiers are identified as having appropriate expertise to provide scheme data assurance.
facts.expected_handling: Use the recognised list rather than self-declared verifier status.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 RTFO and SAF Mandate third-party assurance guidance was added on 15 December 2025 for the 2026 scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Attach assurance-guidance vintage to verification work.

facts.source_fact: The recognised verifier list was updated in June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Check verifier recognition against the current list date.

facts.source_fact: The recognised-verifier publication states that the recognition period was extended through the end of 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Validate verifier recognition against the applicable validity window.

facts.source_fact: It is the fuel supplier's responsibility to appoint the independent verifier.
facts.expected_handling: Keep supplier and verifier responsibilities distinct.

facts.source_fact: Third-party assurance guidance covers verification planning and risk assessment.
facts.expected_handling: Carry risk-assessment provenance into assurance evidence.

facts.source_fact: The guidance covers development of an assurance strategy.
facts.expected_handling: Require an assurance approach appropriate to the submitted data.

facts.source_fact: The guidance covers reporting and assurance statements.
facts.expected_handling: Retain assurance statements with verified carbon and sustainability data.

facts.source_fact: The guidance addresses recognition of voluntary schemes and other national systems.
facts.expected_handling: Record recognised-scheme provenance where used.

facts.source_fact: RTFO carbon and sustainability data must be verified before certificate award.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat unverified data as certificate-qualified.

facts.source_fact: The common assurance publication covers both RTFO and SAF Mandate requirements, with scheme-specific assurance duties.
facts.expected_handling: Keep RTFO and SAF assurance scopes separately labelled.

facts.source_fact: The RTFO collection was updated on 28 May 2026 and includes current guidance and the latest annual-report material.
facts.expected_handling: Use current collection metadata when selecting scheme guidance.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited RTFO fact without broadening its scope.
Attach supplier, fuel, certificate and RTFO-versus-SAF boundary before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing scheme or fuel scopes.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach scheme year and verifier-recognition validity period.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents stale verifier or guidance use.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry assurance level, verifier recognition and source-guidance provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert RTFO fuel assurance or certificate data into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
